label: rem:isotope-knot-properties
title: Isotopes are knot-distinct with independent stability
html:
Two isotopes are knot-distinct. The Markov closures of T_{w_1} and T_{w_2} generally have different Jones polynomials whenever N_1 \neq N_2. The neutron-quark blocks contribute distinct Hecke generators. Isotopes are distinct knots, not the same knot at different substrate parameters.

Stability per isotope is independent. The LP-dual ILP-feasibility is computed on the full NF T_w. This includes the w_{\bar q^N} and w_{\mathrm{inter}} blocks. Different isotopes can have different stabilities at the same q. This is the categorical analogue of the classical observation that {}^{12}\mathrm{C} is stable while {}^{14}\mathrm{C} is not.
